title: Deterministic RAG & Secure Agent Integration
summary: Build zero-hallucination hybrid RAG pipelines, pgvector tenant metadata filtering, and Zod-validated agent tool loops.

problem.headline: AI Hallucinations & Unmanaged LLM Token Costs
points: Generic AI wrappers producing hallucinated answers without clear document attribution.
Unmanaged vector databases risking enterprise data leaks across tenant boundaries.
Unpredictable API token bill shocks and lack of structured agent execution logs.

approach.headline: Hybrid Vector Search & Strict Automated Evals
points: Combine pgvector embeddings with PostgreSQL full-text search for high-precision retrieval.
Enforce tenant metadata filtering directly inside vector queries for hard isolation.
Structure multi-step agent loops with Zod tool schemas, token cost caps, and evals.

deliverables: Production-ready Hybrid RAG Retrieval Engine with pgvector
Deterministic Agent Tool Runner with Zod validation & audit logging
Automated LLM Evaluation Harness measuring retrieval accuracy
